settings.label: Monthly budget
settings.help: The most the factory spends on models in a month. A hard cap: agent steps stop before they could pass it.

settings.label: Product work share
settings.help: Percent of the budget product work may use. The three shares add up to 100.

settings.label: Gardening share
settings.help: Percent of the budget the nightly cleanup may use.

settings.label: Review share
settings.help: Percent of the budget the scheduled review may use.

settings.label: Merge product work by itself
settings.help: Off: a person approves each draft PR. Turn on only when its revert rate gives you reason to.

settings.label: Merge gardening by itself
settings.help: Off: a person approves each cleanup PR.

settings.label: Merge hardening by itself
settings.help: Off: a person approves each hardening PR.

settings.label: Cleanup PRs per night
settings.help: How many cleanup PRs the nightly gardening run may open.

settings.label: Cleanup time
settings.help: The hour (UTC) the nightly cleanup starts. Changing it also changes the schedule in the cleanup workflow.
